lines.en: I give Noriko a call to find that she’s using the music room at school to practice playing bass since Kirin kicked her out of the dorm for being too loud.
lines.zh: 我给 Noriko 打了个电话，发现她正在学校的音乐教室里练贝斯——因为 Kirin 嫌她太吵，把她赶出了宿舍。

lines.en: Not having anything else to do, I decide to drop by as well and listen to her play. As it turns out, though, listening to someone play bass isn’t really as exciting as listening to someone play guitar or...piano.
lines.zh: 反正也没别的事，我决定顺道过去听她弹。结果发现，听人弹贝斯其实不如听人弹吉他或者……钢琴来得带劲。

lines.en: Fortunately, Noriko can apparently play all of those things. So she rotates from instrument to instrument, trying to get me to play as well only to fail miserably.
lines.zh: 好在 Noriko 显然全会。于是她换了一样又一样乐器，还想拉我一起玩，结果惨败。

lines.en: I think this is the part where I’d normally say something about how taken aback by her talent I am but, honestly, Noriko seems like some sort of silent prodigy in a lot of different ways.
lines.zh: 我想，通常这时候我该说点什么，表达自己对她的才华有多惊讶——但说实话，Noriko 在很多方面都像个不声不响的天才。

lines.en: The only thing I can think of that she {i}isn’t{/i} good at is staying away from me, but...let’s face it. There isn’t really {i}anyone{/i} I know who is an expert at that.
lines.zh: 我唯一能想到她{i}不擅长{/i}的事，就是离我远一点，不过……面对现实吧。我认识的人里，真{i}没谁{/i}是这方面的行家。

lines.en: And, for what it’s worth, Noriko’s actually seemed relatively restrained lately.
lines.zh: 而且，话说回来，Noriko 最近看起来还算是比较克制的。

lines.en: I’m not sure if it’s because of her sister’s feelings weighing her down or...something {i}else{/i} that I’ve yet to uncover, but...
lines.zh: 我不确定是因为她姐姐的感情压得她喘不过气，还是……{i}别的{/i}什么我还没发现的东西，不过……

lines.en: Well, whatever it is, I hope it doesn’t last long.
lines.zh: 嗯，不管是什么，我希望它别持续太久。

lines.en: The truth is that, and don’t tell Maya I said this, I’ve wanted to get “closer” to Noriko since she first walked [[back] into my life.
lines.zh: 实话说——别告诉 Maya 是我说的——从她第一次重新走进我生命里那天起，我就想和 Noriko「更近一步」了。

lines.en: It just seems like every chance we’ve had to make that happen has imploded.
lines.zh: 只是我们每一次能让它发生的机会，似乎都自己崩塌了。

lines.en: It’s almost like fate itself is attempting to keep us apart.
lines.zh: 简直像是命运本身在设法拆散我们。

lines.en: I don’t believe that, though. I can’t.
lines.zh: 可我不信这个。我不能信。

lines.en: Even if she is a relic from my past, she’s one that I deserve to have. And it is within the right of no divine power to keep me from that.
lines.zh: 即便她是我过去的遗物，她也是我理应拥有的那一个。而任何神圣力量，都没有权利阻止我。
